title: cbuild_rules
description: Which fit rules a kit runs, and their settings, stored in the _cbuild_rules product meta. Lengths are decimals in text, so no float carries one.

schema_version.description: The document's version. Version 1 is the only one so far.

range_tolerance.description: How far outside a maker's deck range still fits, in inches.

axle_warn.description: And how far it may be and warn, in inches; beyond it the truck is blocked. Not less than axle_fit.

risers.description: The riser table, shortest reach first: a wheel up to `over` millimetres past the limit takes a riser `riser` inches thick. Each row reaches further than the one before.
